step1_analysis.description: A highly linear continuous-time OTA based on complementary differential pairs. It features source degeneration using MOS transistors operating in the triode region to boost transconductance and improve linearity, serving as the core of a 7th-order linear phase filter.

paper_reference.title: A 60-mW 200-MHz Continuous-Time Seventh-Order Linear Phase Filter With On-Chip Automatic Tuning System

paper_reported.value: 58 dB (Dynamic range, gain not explicitly stated but implied high)

sky130_expected.calculation: Gm * Rout. With complementary pairs, Gm is doubled. Rout is the parallel combination of NMOS and PMOS output resistance.
sky130_expected.reasoning: In 130nm, intrinsic gain is lower than 0.35um, typically 40-50dB for a single stage without cascodes.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gm / (2 * pi * C_load). Assuming Gm ~ 1mS and C_load = 1pF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: To achieve a 200MHz filter, the OTA UGBW must be significantly higher, typically >500MHz. SKY130 is faster than 0.35um, so >1GHz is achievable.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin at unity gain frequency

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard stability requirement for OTAs in filter applications.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the OTA

sky130_expected.calculation: I_VDD * 1.8V. Filter has ~7 biquads/integrators, so one OTA is ~1/10th of total power.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled from the 60mW total filter power, expecting a few mW per OTA.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, unity gain bandwidth, phase margin, and transient response of the OTA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* OTA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmrp=5u L_xmrp=0.5u
.param W_xm2_r=5u L_xm2_r=0.5u
.param W_xm1_r=5u L_xm1_r=0.5u
.param W_xm1_l=5u L_xm1_l=0.5u
.param W_xmnb_l=5u L_xmnb_l=0.5u
.param W_xm2_l=5u L_xm2_l=0.5u
.param W_xmpb_l=5u L_xmpb_l=0.5u
.param W_xmnb_r=5u L_xmnb_r=0.5u
.param W_xmrn_r=5u L_xmrn_r=0.5u
.param W_xmpb_r=5u L_xmpb_r=0.5u
.param W_xmrn_l=5u L_xmrn_l=0.5u

XMRP N6 VT_P N9 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmrp} w={W_xmrp}
XM2_R OUTP VIN N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2_r} w={W_xm2_r}
XM1_R OUTP VIN N5 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1_r} w={W_xm1_r}
XM1_L OUTN VIP N2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1_l} w={W_xm1_l}
XMNB_L N2 VCMFB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmnb_l} w={W_xmnb_l}
XM2_L OUTN VIP N9 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2_l} w={W_xm2_l}
XMPB_L N9 VB2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmpb_l} w={W_xmpb_l}
XMNB_R N5 VCMFB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmnb_r} w={W_xmnb_r}
XMRN_R VCM VT_N N5 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmrn_r} w={W_xmrn_r}
XMPB_R N6 VB2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmpb_r} w={W_xmpb_r}
XMRN_L VCM VT_N N2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmrn_l} w={W_xmrn_l}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0

VVB2 VB2 0 0.9
VVT_P VT_P 0 0.9
VVT_N VT_N 0 0.9
VVCM VCM 0 0.9

* Ideal CMFB to hold output common-mode at 0.9V
B_CMFB VCMFB 0 V=0.9+(V(OUTP)+V(OUTN)-1.8)*10

* Inputs with DC, AC, and Transient Sine Wave
VVIP VIP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.25 100MEG)
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 -0.25 100MEG)

* Load Capacitors
CL1 OUTP 0 1p
CL2 OUTN 0 1p
R_diff OUTP OUTN 1G

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1k 10G
let vout_diff = v(OUTP) - v(OUTN)
let gain_db = 20*log10(mag(vout_diff))
let phase = 180/PI * cph(vout_diff)
let pm = 180 + phase

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_margin find pm when gain_db=0 fall=1

tran 10p 50n
meas tran vout_max max v(OUTP)
meas tran vout_min min v(OUTP)
quit
.endc
